title: Smart Data Models - Agrifood / AgriManagementZone
description: A zone inside an agricultural parcel, either drawn by hand (for example an experimental design) or derived by a method such as vegetation index clustering, terrain or topographic wetness. All the zones produced by one zoning run share a run identifier and together partition the parcel.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AgriManagementZone

location.description: GeoProperty. Geometry of the zone. Only Polygon or MultiPolygon are allowed

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Parcel that contains the zone

zoningMethod.description: Property. Enum:'manual, vegetationIndex, terrain, topographicWetness, soilSurvey, yieldMap, other'. Method used to delineate the zone

zoningRunId.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Identifier shared by all the zones produced by the same zoning run. A new run replaces the zones of the previous one

dateZoned.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the zoning run that produced the zone was carried out

zoneLabel.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Human readable label of the zone within its parcel, for example Z1 or Block A

zoneRank.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Display order of the zone among the zones of the same run, starting at 1

zoneClass.description: Property. Enum:'low, medium, high'. Relative class of the zone for the variable used to delineate it

variableAttribute.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the variable used to delineate the zone, for example NDVI or elevation

meanValue.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Mean value of the delineating variable inside the zone, in the units of that variable

area.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m2'. Area of the zone in square meters
